svg.text: Type a task the way you say it out loud
Saved and listed before anything is proposed.
Group meeting about the presentation tomorrow
Pick up shift timesheet from boss today
Group meeting about the presentation tomorrow
Pick up shift timesheet from boss today
Every Smart List above is worked out again each time this screen draws.
Membership is never stored, and you never build or maintain one.
Need Attention: past due, not completed
proposed by an engine, not yet yours
Three numbered controls, printed in purple over the task.
You punch each one on its own. Nothing is pre-filed, and the
task keeps the sentence you typed.
